name: consentio
description: A small, frontend-only consent banner for static sites. Pushes Google Consent Mode signals to dataLayer and stores the answer in one cookie.

scripts.build:site: npx webpack --env build=website && node scripts/i18n.mjs --website && cd ./website && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.serve: npx webpack --env build=website && node scripts/i18n.mjs --website && cd ./website && bundle exec jekyll serve
scripts.publish:site: npx webpack --env build=website && node scripts/i18n.mjs --website && cd ./website && bundle exec jekyll build --config _config.yml,_config.prod.yml

author: ChrisMavrommatis
